ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var productName = payload.name --- (vars.outputwix.products default []) filter ((item) -> item.name == productName) map ((item) -> { name: item.name, inStock: item.stock.inStock default false, price: item.price.price default 0.0, brand: item.brand default "Unknown", size: (item.productOptions default []) filter ((opt) -> opt.name == "Size") flatMap ((sizeOption) -> (sizeOption.choices default []) filter ((choice )-> choice.inStock) map ((choice) -> choice.value) ), URL: item.media.mainMedia.image.url default "", color: (item.productOptions default []) filter ((opt )-> opt.name == "Color") flatMap ((colorOption) -> (colorOption.choices default []) filter ((choice) -> choice.inStock) map ((choice )-> choice.value) ), reference: (item.productOptions default []) filter ((opt )-> opt.name == "reference") flatMap ((colorOption) -> (colorOption.choices default []) filter ((choice) -> choice.inStock) map ((choice )-> choice.value) ), dimensions: (item.productOptions default []) filter ((opt )-> opt.name == "dimensions") flatMap ((colorOption) -> (colorOption.choices default []) filter ((choice) -> choice.inStock) map ((choice )-> choice.value) ) })

%dw 2.0 output application/json var brandName = vars.brand
--- (payload default []) filter ((item) -> brandName == null or item.brand == brandName)

%dw 2.0 output application/json var quantity = vars.quantity default 1 // Définit une valeur par défaut si `quantity` est null var price = payload[0].price default 0 // Définit une valeur par défaut si `price` est null --- { "total": price * quantity }
